```{r setup}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "~/Alyssa/Single_Cell_CHIP_Vascular/")
library(Seurat)
library(CellChat)
library(khroma)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
save_plot = function(plot, file, legend = TRUE, width = 4, height = 4, png = FALSE, svg = FALSE) {
  if (png) { ggsave(plot = plot, filename =  paste0(file, ".png"), dpi = 600, width = ifelse(legend, width, width - 1.5), height = height, units = 'in') }
  if (svg) { ggsave(plot = plot, filename =  paste0(file, ".svg"), dpi = 600, width = ifelse(legend, width, width - 1.5), height = height, units = 'in') }
  ggsave(plot = plot, filename =  paste0(file, ".pdf"), dpi = 600, width = ifelse(legend, width, width - 1.5), height = height, units = 'in')
}
```

# Prepare PBMC data.
```{r}
seu_pbmcs_annotated = readRDS("rds_objects/6_pbmcs_harmonized.rds")
seu_pbmcs_annotated$CHIP[seu_pbmcs_annotated$Patient_ID == "CH-21-006"] = "DNMT3A"
seu_pbmcs_annotated$CHIP[seu_pbmcs_annotated$Patient_ID == "CH-21-014"] = "TET2"
seu_pbmcs_annotated$CHIP[seu_pbmcs_annotated$CHIP == "control"] = "Control"

```

# Prepare adipose data.
```{r}
seu_adipose_annotated = readRDS("rds_objects/5_annotated_adipose.rds")
seu_adipose_annotated$Patient_ID = seu_adipose_annotated$HATIMID
seu_adipose_annotated$cell_type = gsub("\\/", " and ", seu_adipose_annotated$cell_type)

```


# Merge monocytes and endothelial cells.
```{r}
endothelial = subset(seu_adipose_annotated, subset = (cell_type == "Endothelial"))
cd14_monos = subset(seu_pbmcs_annotated, subset = (cell_type == "Classical Monocytes"))

mono_endo = merge(endothelial, cd14_monos)
mono_endo$cell_subtype = ifelse(!is.na(mono_endo$Annotation), mono_endo$Annotation, mono_endo$cell_type)
```


# Function to create objects.
```{r}
create_cc = function(seu_obj, output_path, secreted_only = FALSE) {
  cellchat = createCellChat(object = seu_obj, meta = seu_obj@meta.data, group.by = "cell_subtype") 
  CellChatDB = CellChatDB.human
  
  if (secreted_only) {
    CellChatDB.use = subsetDB(CellChatDB, search = "Secreted Signaling")
  } else {
    CellChatDB.use = CellChatDB
  }
  cellchat@DB = CellChatDB.use

  cellchat = subsetData(cellchat)
  cellchat = identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat)
  cellchat = identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat) 
  cellchat = projectData(cellchat, PPI.human) 
  cellchat = computeCommunProb(cellchat, type = 'truncatedMean') 
  cellchat = filterCommunication(cellchat, min.cells = 25) 
  cellchat = computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat) 
  cellchat = aggregateNet(cellchat)
  cellchat = netAnalysis_computeCentrality(cellchat, slot.name = "netP")

  saveRDS(cellchat, output_path)
  return(cellchat)
}

```

# Merge objects and run cellchat.
```{r}
subtypes_merged.list = SplitObject(mono_endo, split.by = "CHIP")

subtypes_merged_tet2 = subtypes_merged.list$TET2
subtypes_merged_dnmt3a = subtypes_merged.list$DNMT3A
subtypes_merged_control = subtypes_merged.list$Control

create_cc(subtypes_merged_tet2, "rds_objects/cellchat/subtypes_adipose_pbmc_tet2_cc.rds")
create_cc(subtypes_merged_dnmt3a, "rds_objects/cellchat/subtypes_adipose_pbmc_dnmt3a_cc.rds")
create_cc(subtypes_merged_control, "rds_objects/cellchat/subtypes_adipose_pbmc_control_cc.rds")

```


# Load objects.
```{r}
subtypes_adipose_pbmc_tet2_cc = readRDS("rds_objects/cellchat/subtypes_adipose_pbmc_tet2_cc.rds")
subtypes_adipose_pbmc_dnmt3a_cc = readRDS("rds_objects/cellchat/subtypes_adipose_pbmc_dnmt3a_cc.rds")
subtypes_adipose_pbmc_control_cc = readRDS("rds_objects/cellchat/subtypes_adipose_pbmc_control_cc.rds")
```

# Merge objects.
```{r}
subtypes_adipose_pbmc_cc.list = list(TET2 = subtypes_adipose_pbmc_tet2_cc, DNMT3A = subtypes_adipose_pbmc_dnmt3a_cc, Control = subtypes_adipose_pbmc_control_cc)
subtypes_adipose_pbmc_cc = mergeCellChat(subtypes_adipose_pbmc_cc.list, add.names = names(subtypes_adipose_pbmc_cc.list))
subtypes_adipose_pbmc_cc = updateCellChat(subtypes_adipose_pbmc_cc)
```



# Monocyte <--> endothelial cell signaling.
```{r}

(subtypes_arterial_mono_endo_grouped_rank = rankNet(subtypes_adipose_pbmc_cc, mode = "comparison", comparison = c(1, 2, 3), sources.use = c("Classical Monocytes", "Arterial EC"), targets.use = c("Classical Monocytes", "Arterial EC"), signaling = c("CCL", "ICAM", "VCAM", "SELPLG", "CXCL", "SELL", "ITGB2", "PECAM1"), do.stat = TRUE, color.use = c("#3E7274",  "#584482", "grey"), title = "Classical Monocytes <--> Arterial EC") + aes(x = contribution.scaled, y = name) + ylab("") + xlab("Signaling strength") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))) 

(subtypes_capillary_mono_endo_grouped_rank = rankNet(subtypes_adipose_pbmc_cc, mode = "comparison", comparison = c(1, 2, 3), sources.use = c("Classical Monocytes", "Capillary EC"), targets.use = c("Classical Monocytes", "Capillary EC"), signaling = c("CCL", "ICAM", "VCAM", "SELPLG", "CXCL", "SELL", "ITGB2", "PECAM1"), do.stat = TRUE, color.use = c("#3E7274",  "#584482", "grey"), title = "Classical Monocytes <--> Capillary EC") + aes(x = contribution.scaled, y = name) + ylab("") + xlab("Signaling strength") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))) 

(subtypes_venous_mono_endo_grouped_rank = rankNet(subtypes_adipose_pbmc_cc, mode = "comparison", comparison = c(1, 2, 3), sources.use = c("Classical Monocytes", "Venous EC"), targets.use = c("Classical Monocytes", "Venous EC"), signaling = c("CCL", "ICAM", "VCAM", "SELPLG", "CXCL", "SELL", "ITGB2", "PECAM1"), do.stat = TRUE, color.use = c("#3E7274",  "#584482", "grey"), title = "Classical Monocytes <--> Venous EC") + aes(x = contribution.scaled, y = name) + ylab("") + xlab("Signaling strength") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))) 

save_plot(subtypes_arterial_mono_endo_grouped_rank, "figures/cellchat/subtypes_arterial_mono_endo_grouped_rank", width = 4, height = 3, png = TRUE)
save_plot(subtypes_capillary_mono_endo_grouped_rank, "figures/cellchat/subtypes_capillary_mono_endo_grouped_rank", width = 4, height = 3, png = TRUE)
save_plot(subtypes_venous_mono_endo_grouped_rank, "figures/cellchat/subtypes_venous_mono_endo_grouped_rank", width = 4, height = 3, png = TRUE)

```
